title: Humidity, Three Ways
creator: Hank R. & Claude Code
subject: Environmental Monitoring
description: Lock the water content, change only the temperature, and watch relative humidity climb to 100 per cent while the dew point does not move at all.

learningObjectives: Distinguish absolute humidity, relative humidity and dew point.
Explain why relative humidity changes when nothing was added to the air.
prerequisites: Chapter 8 sections on what water vapour is
Reading a curve off a graph

keyQuestions: You cooled the air and relative humidity went up. Where did the extra water come from?
Which of the three numbers would you log, and why?
Why does a heated house in winter feel dry?
commonMisconceptions: Believing cool air "holds less water" as a property of the water rather than of the temperature.
Treating relative humidity as a measure of how much water is present.
Thinking a heater dries the air.
assessmentOpportunities: Explains why relative humidity changed when nothing was added to the air.
States the dew point as a property of the water content alone.
Distinguishes the three measures by saying what each one is a ratio of, or not.
